seats.findings:
🔴 [coupon-divisor] MUST-FIX src/coupon.js:5 divides by 1000 instead of 100, so couponCents(1000, 10) returns 10 instead of 100 and every discount (and checkoutTotal via it) is 10x too small; change the divisor to 100
🟠 [ship-floor-not-ceil] MUST-FIX src/ship.js:6 uses Math.floor on the extra weight, so a started 500 g block is not charged (shippingCents(1001) returns 500 instead of 600); use Math.ceil(extra / 500)

🟠 [coupon-div-1000] MUST-FIX src/coupon.js:5 divides by 1000 instead of 100 (`Math.round((subtotal * p) / 1000)`), so every discount is 10x too small (subtotal=10000, pct=10 returns 100 instead of 1000); this also propagates into checkoutTotal's taxable amount via src/checkout.js:6. Smallest remediation: change the divisor to 100.
🟠 [ship-floor-not-ceil] MUST-FIX src/ship.js:6 uses `Math.floor(extra / 500)` but the contract charges 100 cents per started additional 500 g, so any partially started block undercharges (weightG=1001 returns 500 instead of 600; 1001–1499 all return 500); this propagates into checkoutTotal via src/checkout.js:7. Smallest remediation: `Math.ceil(extra / 500) * 100`.

🟠 [coupon-divisor] MUST-FIX src/coupon.js:4 divides by 1000 instead of 100; spec requires Math.round(subtotal * pct / 100) but code computes Math.round((subtotal * p) / 1000), yielding a discount 10× too small (e.g. couponCents(10000, 10) returns 10 instead of 1000); this also corrupts checkoutTotal which delegates here; change the divisor to 100
🟠 [ship-ceil] MUST-FIX src/ship.js:5 uses Math.floor(extra / 500) but "each started additional 500 g" requires ceiling; for weight 1001 g the code returns 500 instead of 600, and for 1501 g returns 600 instead of 700; replace Math.floor with Math.ceil so every begun 500 g block is charged
